visual_goal: Show Part III's ten chapters as four stages: follow the money, decide authority, design the seams, grow and change, ending with one provable estate.
prompt: A left-to-right sequence of four wide panels joined by arrows. At the far left: a trail of coins with a magnifying glass, labeled 'Follow the money', with a stack of three books. Next: a crown resting on one of three boxes, labeled 'Authority', with a stack of three books. Next: two puzzle pieces joined by a stitched seam, labeled 'Design the seams', with a stack of two books. Next: a growing plant beside a small building, labeled 'Grow and change', with a stack of two books. The panel corners are plain and clean. One arrow from each panel to the next. At the far right a check-marked seal labeled 'One provable system', with one arrow into it. Exactly four arrows.
alt: Four stages joined by arrows: follow the money, decide authority, design the seams and grow and change, ending at one provable system.
